cases.observed_analysis: No first failing command or diagnostic exists. A red conclusion does not identify a code or runner defect.

cases.closure_criteria: An authorized new run on the appropriate head must actually exercise the check.

cases.observed_analysis: The user cancelled the job, and the excerpt contains no technical test failure. A code change would be speculative.
evidence: No failing step or process error in supplied excerpt
cases.proposed_verification: Confirm original cancellation receipt; if desired, request a fully completed run at the recorded commit.
cases.closure_criteria: A later complete run, not cancellation alone, establishes test outcome.

inspect API output and Windows expectation independently

cases.observed_analysis: The private registry denied npm ci, but neither expired identity nor missing package privilege has been established; the log proves no leak.

blockers.check: separate credential validity and package ACL checks

cases.observed_analysis: The parser rejected an unexpected closing brace. No evidence supports an unrelated second cause; tests never ran and proposed a2 is unverified.

cases.closure_criteria: Only an observed lint and test pass on FIX_HEAD a2 proves repair; original f1 remains failed.

cases.observed_analysis: TypeScript rejects a string assigned to a number. f2 fails twice; b2 is a distinct proposed fix with no CI evidence.

Attempt 2 same original commit: tsc --noEmit => exited 2
No CI result for fix candidate

blockers.check: compare runtime producer and schema at line 8

cases.observed_analysis: The first attempt timed out, the second passed, and no source repair is demonstrated. Timing race and runner load are plausible.

blockers.cause: test timing defect or runner scheduling variation
blockers.check: controlled repeat with timing/runner trace

cases.proposed_verification: Instrument stage latency and test synchronization under controlled runner load; persistent wait under low load versus load-correlated slowness favors different causes.
cases.closure_criteria: Repeated representative passing attempts and root cause evidence required; retry alone is insufficient.

cases.observed_analysis: Exit 137 indicates termination consistent with SIGKILL but does not prove OOM.
evidence: No cgroup OOM-kill counters, runner cancellation reason or memory peak included

blockers.check: OOM events and runner stop reason for same attempt

cases.proposed_verification: Compare same-attempt cgroup memory.events OOM counters with external runner cancellation and termination records; only counted OOM at limit supports OOM.
cases.closure_criteria: Require cause-specific remediation and a fresh passing integration run.

cases.observed_analysis: The integration job waited for a test server until the deadline; neither deadlock nor slow startup is proven.
evidence: Last recorded stage: waiting for test server
No thread dump, runner health or service logs

blockers.check: service timestamps and probe target

cases.proposed_verification: Correlate server health/startup time with readiness target: no healthy server supports startup failure; healthy server at other address supports probe misroute.
cases.closure_criteria: Fresh exact-head run must show server readiness and completed tests within contract.

cases.observed_analysis: Certificate validation failed for expiration, but no certificate chain or runner time is supplied; disable-TLS advice would be unsafe.

blockers.check: full chain notAfter/notBefore versus trusted and runner time

blockers.check: three-way independent digest comparison
